inspection: Read zh-CN config schema and Data Fields. Declared fields are path, audio, transcription, english_transcription, intent_class, lang_id; no speaker or session field. This supports the absence of explicit speaker identifiers, not a claim that recordings have distinct speakers.
excerpt:
The data fields are the same among all splits.
path: Path to the audio file
audio: Audio object including loaded audio array, sampling rate and path
transcription: Transcription of the audio file
english_transcription: English transcription of the audio file
intent_class: Class id of intent
lang_id: Id of language
